location.address: No. 312 Woji Road, GRA

testimonials.comment: The hotel is exquisite, has a good environment, safe, serene. Garden City gives you value for your money. I enjoyed their meal, their rooms are super comfortable with a king-size bed with well befitting ecstatics
testimonials.name: Jennie Chukwuemeka

testimonials.comment: I enjoyed their buffet. I heard about the hotel and called them. Their response was good. The staff was friendly and answered my questions. The hotel usually has a buffet in the morning everyday and on Sunday afternoons. They have a variety of foods, snacks, vegetables and soups. I was impressed by the food. Their food tasted really good. I ate all their continental dish. Next was their soup which I ate their seafood okro. It was delicious. I couldn't eat the affang soup due to lack of space in my belly.
testimonials.name: Obi chi

places.name: Gordonsville Escape Boutique Hotel & Spa
places.description: Gordonsville Escape Boutique Hotel & Spa is a 20-room, exclusive, award-winning luxury boutique hotel set on acres of lush gardens in the heart of Port Harcourt. It offers an intimate and luxurious retreat for discerning travelers.

location.address: Bozgomero Estate, 30 Abuloma Rd, opposite FCMB Bank, Trans Amadi

testimonials.comment: I stayed here 12 days, and it is really a nice boutique hotel. Several gates, very safe. The cleaning crew came in every day when I allowed them to. I gave it 4 stars because they give you one pack of tea with two small sugars a day. I do not drink coffee, but two small sugars is ridiculously to me. I asked for more, and they said I only get two a day. I like two sugars in one cup of tea, but sometimes I like two or three cups of hot tea when I’m in hotels a day.
testimonials.name: Shalanda Cowans

testimonials.comment: The rooms and the environment is top notch. The service is sub par, the staff act like they're doing this against their will (are they?). The rooms are not sound proof so the smallest excited conversation and you're told to keep it down like in primary school.
testimonials.name: Clinton

testimonials.comment: This is such a beautiful place and the customer service was beyond remarkable. It is in a quiet and serene environment, there is no unnecessary noise, the food tastes great, the poolside is beautiful, the AC is working perfectly. I wish I could stay longer I really enjoyed my stay here I will definitely recommend it to my friends.
testimonials.name: Chukwu Melissa
